name: Falak
author: Adnan Ali
description: Prayer times, qibla, moon, Ramadan and the hijri date, computed on this machine from the sun and moon, for anywhere in the world. No network.

barWidget.description: Next prayer and a sky panel: the sun's path, the moon, the qibla

schema.label: Method: auto (by country), or one of the 26 in the panel's picker (m)
Asr: auto (by country), hanafi or standard
High-latitude rule: angle, seventh, middle or none
Place chosen in the panel; absent follows the weather widget
Language: auto (system), en, ar, ur, fa, tr, ms, id, fr, bn
Numerals: auto (native for Arabic and Persian), native or western
